Flight Phase

Стандартный вылет

A pre-planned IFR departure route (SID) published for use by departing aircraft, providing obstacle clearance and efficient traffic flow.

Quick answer: A pre-planned IFR departure route (SID) published for use by departing aircraft, providing obstacle clearance and efficient traffic flow.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Стандартный вылет?

In this glossary, Стандартный вылет refers to: A pre-planned IFR departure route (SID) published for use by departing aircraft, providing obstacle clearance and efficient traffic flow.

How is Стандартный вылет used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Ожидайте стандартный вылет Kennedy Four. Сообщите о готовности к разрешению и подтвердите получение текущего ATIS."

Why does Стандартный вылет matter in aviation?

Стандартный вылет matters because it supports clear communication in Flight Phase contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Стандартный вылет?

Стандартный вылет is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Стандартный вылет belong to?

In this glossary, Стандартный вылет is grouped under Flight Phase. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A pre-planned IFR departure route (SID) published for use by departing aircraft, providing obstacle clearance and efficient traffic flow.

Operational example

Expect the Kennedy Four standard departure. Advise when ready for the clearance and confirm receipt of the current ATIS.

Localized term

Стандартный вылет

Localized example
